_doc: Green Home Score sub-score mappings v0.1. Fixed weights from the problem statement. Every mapping is monotonic (better state never lowers the sub-score) and is unit-tested. Piecewise-linear 'points' are [x, sub_score] pairs, linearly interpolated, clamped at the ends. Owner: Physics & Bayesian lead. Changes need a PR + updated tests.

changelog.0.2.0: Added U-value curves (walls, roof, floor) for homes with a known or EPC-reported U-value (decision D-15). Roof U maps through RdSAP 10 Table 16 to an equivalent loft depth, so both paths agree.
changelog.0.3.0: Loft curve is now physics-based: share of the maximum heat-loss cut, 100 x (U0 - U(mm)) / (U0 - Umin), U from RdSAP 10 Table 16 (U0 = 2.3 at 0 mm, Umin = 0.11 at 400 mm). Replaces the near-linear curve, which the EBM check (decision D-23) showed under-valued the first 100 mm.
changelog.0.4.0: Lighting scored inside smart_energy_management: 0.53 x controls level + 0.47 x low-energy lighting %, share learned from RdSAP 10 data (decision D-26).

rounding: Round final weighted sum to nearest integer (half up) before classification.

energy_efficiency.input: EPC SAP score (1-100); if only band is known use band midpoint
energy_efficiency.post_retrofit: After a retrofit there is no lodged EPC: the sub-score uses the documented post-retrofit rating estimator (contracts/sap_estimator.json), labelled 'estimated rating, not an EPC'.
energy_efficiency.justification: Problem statement: energy efficiency must reflect the recorded energy rating (or a documented rating-based measure).

energy_intensity.input: Annualised metered energy per m2, as defined in the problem statement: (grid electricity import + gas, kWh over the available months, annualised) / total floor area. NOT weather-normalised.
energy_intensity.annualisation: Sum of available months scaled to 12 months using each missing month's typical share of annual use (degree-day shares for gas, flat shares for electricity); months with no data are never treated as zero; < 6 months -> flagged low confidence; 0 months -> intensity unavailable, sub-score taken from the twin-modelled intensity with a warning and a wider interval.
energy_intensity.sensitivity: A weather-normalised intensity (typical-year degree days) is reported alongside as a sensitivity, not used in the score.
energy_intensity.justification: Metered and per m2, so large homes are not penalised for size alone; distinct from the rating-based energy-efficiency component.
energy_intensity.overlap_with_renewables: Solar PV affects two components: renewable_energy credits installed generation capacity, and energy_intensity falls because PV self-consumption reduces metered grid import. We keep both because the problem statement defines intensity on metered energy and renewables as a separate lever. Justification: intensity measures what the home actually buys; renewables rewards on-site generation the meter does not see (exports and capacity). Disclosure: the evaluation reports the score with and without PV self-consumption added back to intensity, so the size of the overlap is visible.

insulation.renormalise_when_absent: Flats with a dwelling above drop 'roof'; with a dwelling below drop 'floor'; remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1.
insulation.roof_loft_rule: sub_score = 100 x (2.3 - U(mm)) / (2.3 - 0.11), U(mm) from RdSAP 10 Table 16 (see roof_u_to_loft_mm); points above are that formula at every table depth, rounded to 2 dp

roof_u_to_loft_mm.source: RdSAP 10 specification (BRE, Feb 2024) Table 16, column 'insulation at joists at ceiling level and flat roof'

insulation.u_value_rule: When an element's U-value is known (measured, or 'Average thermal transmittance' on the EPC) the U-value curve is used instead of the category. Lower U never lowers the sub-score.
insulation.justification: Insulation is an actionable lever; overlap with the EPC rating is accepted and documented: the rating is an overall modelled outcome, components are the levers customers can change.

heating_system.input: Main heating system (+ age for boilers)
heating_system.age_adjustment: Boilers: -1 point per year over 12 years old, floor 0.
heating_system.justification: Ordered by delivered-heat carbon intensity and seasonal efficiency.

renewable_energy.input: PV kWp, battery kWh, solar thermal

smart_energy_management.input: Controls present + share of low-energy (LED/CFL) fixed lighting
smart_energy_management.combine: sub_score = (1 - lighting_share) x controls_level + lighting_share x low_energy_lighting_pct (0-100). Missing lighting % is sampled from the EPC prior, never 0.
smart_energy_management.lighting_justification: The brief fixes seven components, so lighting joins this one as 'controls and efficient electricity use'. lighting_share is learned (decision D-26): simplex NNLS on RdSAP 10 certificates, lighting share of this component 0.463 (SAP target) and 0.472 (primary energy); adding lighting raises held-out R2 on all four modelled targets. Overlap with energy efficiency (SAP already counts lighting) is accepted on the same basis as insulation: the rating is an outcome, components are levers.
smart_energy_management.rule: controls_level = highest level whose requirements are all present.
